title: KCP negotiation shapes (DESIGN.md §11.1): HelloRequest and HelloResult
description: Negotiation per §11.1: every connection-oriented binding begins with hello; one-shot HTTP requests carry the selected major/minor version in the media type or version header instead. The server selects the highest mutually supported version or returns unsupported-version. Authentication occurs in the transport before hello or through a binding-defined credential, never an identity claim in HelloRequest — which is why the closed request shape carries no identity or credential member. §11.1 pins the field names but not their types; the array/string/digest encodings here are recorded extraction decisions (spec/schemas/README.md). The root validates either shape; vectors target #/$defs/helloRequest and #/$defs/helloResult.

protocolVersion.description: KCP major.minor version; the initial protocol version is "0.1" (§11).

identifier.description: Opaque identifier, at most 128 bytes (§11.8); visible-ASCII alphabet is a K0 extraction decision (spec/schemas/README.md).

featureId.description: Feature-bundle name from the §11.6 table (e.g. core_v1, shared_space_v1). Bundles are atomic: an implementation implements every operation/schema/conformance case in a listed bundle or does not advertise it. An installation advertises the transitive prerequisites with a feature (§11.6).

timestamp.description: RFC 3339 date-time (I-JSON recommendation; DESIGN.md does not pin the encoding — recorded extraction decision).

digestHex.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 value of a §11.8 typed digest; the type/domain is fixed by the schema field holding it.

supported_versions.description: Client-supported protocol versions; at most 256 list items per request (§11.8).

implementation.description: Client implementation name; free text bounded by the §11.8 display-name cap of 256 Unicode scalar values (recorded extraction decision), length-bounded again at admission.

implementation_version.description: Client implementation version string, bounded by the §11.8 identifier cap (recorded extraction decision).

requested_features.description: Feature bundles the client wants; may be empty. A feature must be negotiated before use (§11.9); operations from an unadvertised feature return unknown-op (§11.6).

helloRequest.description: HelloRequest { supported_versions[], implementation, implementation_version, requested_features[] } (§11.1). Carries no identity claim by construction.

selected_version.description: Highest mutually supported version (§11.1); no common version is the unsupported-version problem instead of a HelloResult.

features.description: Advertised feature bundles including transitive prerequisites (§11.6).

limits_digest.description: Typed digest of the installation's effective limits. DESIGN.md names the field without pinning the limits object or its §11.8 construction — a recorded K0 gap (spec/schemas/README.md).

helloResult.description: HelloResult { selected_version, implementation, implementation_version, features[], limits_digest, server_time, installation_id } (§11.1).
